metaDescription: Bearded Collie vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Bearded Collie boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Bearded Collie social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Bearded Collie exposure.
Weight range 45-55 lb (20-25 kg) and grooming needs (Long coat high maintenance.) belong in the same Bearded Collie household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Bearded Collie is also monitored for hypothyroidism, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Bearded Collie appointments.
After the Bearded Collie puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Bearded Collie boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Bearded Collie row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Bearded Collie item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Bearded Collie kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Bearded Collie due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Bearded Collie core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Bearded Collie misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Bearded Collie health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Bearded Collie adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
